name: zigbee-power
experiment:
# Real hardware: Nordic PPK2 + nRF52840 802.15.4 sniffer in ONE session.
#
# Wiring: the DUT is powered from the PPK2 (source mode, VOUT/GND), or the PPK2
# is in series with an external supply (ampere mode). The sniffer DK listens on
# the channel the DUT's radio uses.
#
#   hwlab run examples/zigbee-power.yaml --yes     # --yes: confirms the supply voltage
#
# Timing: both devices are started back-to-back by the experiment engine. Each
# has its own clock; see the clock.* metadata of the session and the pcapng
# artifact. Cross-device accuracy is NOT nanosecond-level: it is bounded by the
# sniffer USB latency (milliseconds) and by the PPK2 start latency.
name: zigbee-power
duration: 10s

devices:
  power:
    plugin: ppk2
    requires: [PowerMeasurement]
    mode: ampere              # "source" drives the DUT supply: needs --yes
    # mode: source
    # supply_mv: 3300
  radio:
    plugin: nrf802154
    requires: [PacketCapture]
    channel: 15

analysis:
  nominal_voltage: 3.3

plots:
  - name: overview
    title: PPK2 current + 802.15.4 packets
    format: png
  - name: overview
    title: PPK2 current + 802.15.4 packets
    format: svg

clock.source: sample count x 10 us from the host time of the AVERAGE_START write
clock.note: the PPK2 has no per-sample timestamps; the start of sampling is bounded by the write time (late side) and by data arrival (early side), assuming the device clock does not drift over the first 2 s; later drift is not measured; fixture decimated 10:1, stored periods 100 us, original clock bounds retained

clock.source: device timer (us since boot), mapped by minimum-offset estimator
clock.note: relative timing between frames is device-timer accurate (1 us); absolute alignment is late by the unknown minimum USB transit latency; host receive minus stamped time was 3.8 ms mean, 16.8 ms max (not a bound)
